title: Countable localization of a locally Lipschitz map into globally Lipschitz pieces
statement: Let n, Q ∈ ℕ, let Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ be open, and let u : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q be locally Lipschitz on Ω (ℝᵐ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)). Then there are open sets B_m ⊆ Ω (m ∈ ℕ) with Ω ⊆ ⋃_m B_m, and Lipschitz maps v_m : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q (each with some Lipschitz constant K_m ≥ 0), such that v_m = u on B_m for every m.
lean_statement: ∀ (n Q : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (u : Eucl n → Eucl Q), IsOpen Ω → LocallyLipschitzOn Ω u → ∃ (B : ℕ → Set (Eucl n)) (v : ℕ → Eucl n → Eucl Q), (∀ m, IsOpen (B m)) ∧ (∀ m, B m ⊆ Ω) ∧ Ω ⊆ ⋃ m, B m ∧ (∀ m, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith K (v m)) ∧ ∀ m, EqOn u (v m) (B m)
